payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped perf-budget checker + NDJSON trend tracking on the FR-97/98 suites. Declarative thresholds (p99 ceilings, throughput floor, memory-growth ceiling) judged into a machine-readable PASS/FAIL verdict (missing metric fails closed); appendHistory/readHistory/compareToBaseline record + diff runs. New  CLI subcommand + pnpm bench:budget (--history/--no-history/--no-fail/--meta). Opt-in non-blocking CI step gated on workflow_dispatch. New apps/server/tests/perf-budget.test.ts (9 tests, <1.5s). typecheck clean; full vitest 1209 passed / 45 skipped.
